content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the KGMU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KGMU Senior Resident (Un-registered) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by King George Medical University (KGMU), located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, for filling various medical and dental residency positions in specialized departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position available under this recruitment notification is Senior Resident (Un-registered) specifically focusing on Plastic Surgery with an M.D.S. in Orthodontics background.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Resident (Un-registered) post under advertisement number 97749/SR/2026 for eligible dental professionals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit online applications beforehand; they can directly participate in the scheduled walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D.S. degree in Orthodontics that is duly recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI) to be eligible for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident post is 45 years. Applicants must verify their age as per the official notification date.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the King George Medical University Senior Resident position is scheduled to be held on 6 October 2026 at the designated campus venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee amounting to Rs. 3000/- as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any fee concession for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC and ST candidates have a reduced application fee of Rs. 2000/- payable according to the guidelines outlined by the university administration.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the university?
faq.answer: You can visit the official web portal of King George Medical University at kgmcindia.edu to find further updates, interview venues, and detailed recruitment notifications.
